trap.label: smell of
trap.wrong: It smells ripe plum and cedar.
trap.right: It smells of ripe plum and cedar.
trap.why: Em português “cheira a ameixa” e o aluno suprime a preposição. Em inglês, smell of/like + substantivo.

fix.wrong: This wine is very approachable and sublime too much.
fix.right: This wine is approachable and utterly sublime.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com smells of: “The aroma is plum.”
Reescreva com tastes of: “The flavor is cedar.”
Reescreva com approachable: “It is easy to enjoy.”
